response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), group_shares AS (SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM group_counts) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(member_count), 0) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM group_shares WHERE share > average_share
